what: Rule permits thin wrappers to delegate to another Python module instead of the canonical cli.py entrypoint
scenario_or_breakage: The new policy conflicts with the existing migration contract that external consumers call python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/python/cli.py directly, so future shell wrappers could bypass the supported CLI surface while still following the new rule
suggested_fix: Remove "or another Python module" from the proposed rule and approach wording; require thin wrappers to delegate through python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/python/cli.py
